L13·N5083unmasked layer
This neuron fires on the linking word (copula "is/was", or "particular"/"the") that introduces a single, *definite* specific instance after an "example/one of the most X" framing (e.g. "a clear example **is** the...", "one of the more recent examples **was** Foxconn's...", "calling out in **particular** the..."), and is strongly suppressed when the following noun phrase is instead indefinite/plural or a quantity ("in several journals", "three different levels", "two more pet cats").
